note: The start URL sets countryId=10060372 (Malaysia) and offerFlag=1. The server fills the hidden countryId field, but a GET of this URL returns the same nine Global featured tiles as the same path with Singapore or Japan country IDs. A country-filtered set would need the on-page Search form POST, which this recipe does not submit. total and merchantPage are both 1 on the saved page, so there is no further GET page.
